rationale: The assistant correctly identified a likely start device/overload fault with possible compressor failure, kept uncertainty, advised safe checks, and escalated to an engineer with useful wording and model details. Minor weaknesses: it hedged on an inverter module (unlikely for this model), called the hot box 'likely the start/overload device' fairly confidently, and the engineer script repeated across turns. Some phrasing like 'Tell them... the freezer temperature rises' included items the customer had reported, so no real fabrication, and it did not mention the cheap plug-on relay option or the repair cost threshold.
